reasoningText.text:
Devon is a member. The triage says to reply with the date/time of the next PTA meeting and confirm whether grandparents are welcome. However, I don't have information about when the next PTA meeting is — it's not in the CLUB FACTS. I shouldn't invent a date. I should let Devon know I'll get back with the details, but I can confirm that grandparents are absolutely welcome (the tone is inclusive, everyone is welcome).

Let me draft a reply that's warm and confirms grandparents are welcome, but says I'll confirm the next meeting date shortly.

input.subject: Re: Next PTA meeting - and can grandparents attend?
input.body:
Hi Devon,

Great questions! Grandparents are absolutely welcome at our PTA meetings — we love when families join in, so please bring yours along!

I don't have the exact date for the next meeting to hand right now, but I'll confirm that and get back to you shortly so you can plan around their visit.

Thanks for reaching out, and hope to see you (and your grandparents!) soon.

Warmly,
Maria Chen
PTA President, Jefferson Elementary
(This reply was drafted by ClubKeeper, the PTA's agent — approved by a human)
